transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this authorization meeting because we have a situation with the polymer resin shipment and I need to decide whether we can proceed with a non-routine material run. As we know, our normal resin shipment is delayed, but we have 210 kilograms of the normal resin and 90 kilograms of an alternate resin lot available in the warehouse. The injection-molding line is idle and could produce 600 housings tomorrow if I authorize the alternate material. Before I can make that binding decision, our pre-run authorization routine requires me to obtain both a materials review and a compliance review. So let's proceed: I need the materials engineer and the compliance specialist to each present their formal review findings. Once I've heard both reviews, I'll record the applicable controls and make my decision.
